q: Two measure-preserving group actions Γ ↷ (X,μ) and Λ ↷ (Y,ν) are orbit equivalent if:
opts: Γ and Λ are isomorphic groups
There is a measure-space isomorphism φ: X → Y that maps Γ-orbits to Λ-orbits
The actions have the same entropy
exp: Orbit equivalence is a coarser equivalence than conjugacy: the groups and their actions may differ, but the orbit partition structures are isomorphic as measured equivalence relations. It ignores the individual group action.
